MEMO
To: Department coordinators
Subject: Annual safety briefing

The annual safety briefing will be held on May 18 in Room 4B. Coordinators should submit attendee names by May 10. Employees who work remotely may join through the video link that will be sent after registration. The briefing materials will be available ___ the session ends.
prompt: Choose the option that best completes the sentence.
explanation: Once means as soon as/after that event; materials become available after the session ends.
quick_solution: Once means as soon as/after that event; materials become available after the session ends.
